CA$14.99. Once. Not a subscription.

Ontario G1 Complete is a one-time purchase through the app. No automatic renewal and no scheduled expiry on the Ontario pack. It is an independent learning tool—not a promise that you will pass.

1. About these terms

These terms apply to your use of the FirstLane app and website, provided by Tervlon Labs. By using FirstLane, you agree to these terms. Please read the Privacy policy for information about data handling. Mandatory rights under applicable consumer law are not limited by these terms.

The app-store listing identifies the authorised publisher or seller for a store transaction. That publisher may be a separate company from the product operator. Apple’s and Google’s applicable store terms also apply to downloads and purchases made through their services.

2. Independent preparation

FirstLane provides Ontario G1 practice and study material. It is not a government agency, the official Ontario G1 test, a licence provider or a driving school. FirstLane is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ontario’s Ministry of Transportation or DriveTest.

Questions, explanations, mock sessions and progress indicators are learning aids. They are not official exam questions, official test results or a guarantee of passing. Consult current official guidance for licensing requirements and road rules. Do not use the app while driving.

3. Eligibility and accounts

FirstLane is intended for learners aged 16 or older. When your age or local law requires it, obtain a parent’s or guardian’s involvement before accepting these terms or making a purchase.

Provide accurate account information and keep your sign-in details secure. You are responsible for activity you authorise on your account. Contact support when you suspect unauthorised use. Some features are available as a guest; others require an account, an internet connection or a valid purchase.

4. Free access

You can try 10 guest questions. A free account includes a fixed set of 40 Ontario practice questions, explanations and saved free progress. The free set is not a rotating daily allowance and is not a time-limited subscription trial. You do not need to enter payment-card details to use free access.

5. Ontario G1 Complete

Ontario G1 Complete has a Canadian reference price of CA$14.99 and is a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase. It unlocks the Ontario pack and associated paid study features, including topic practice, mock sessions, mistake review, bookmarks and downloaded offline study.

It is not an automatically renewing subscription. There is no scheduled expiry on valid Ontario access. Access remains subject to a valid, non-refunded purchase, applicable store rules, account security and service availability. “No scheduled expiry” does not promise that every device or online service will be supported forever.

New jurisdictions are separate packs and are not included unless expressly stated. No recurring charge is created by buying Ontario G1 Complete.

6. Payments, refunds and restoration

Purchases take place inside the app through Apple or Google, not through this website. The store shows the final price in the applicable currency and any taxes before you confirm. The amount shown in the store checkout controls that transaction.

Use the relevant store’s refund process. Eligibility is determined under its policies and applicable consumer law; a refund is not automatically granted. Refunded, reversed or invalid transactions may lose the related paid access.

To restore a valid purchase, sign in to the original FirstLane account, use the relevant store account and follow the restoration instructions. Cross-platform transfer is not promised. Do not buy again simply because access has not yet refreshed; contact support first.

Deleting a FirstLane account does not initiate a refund. It removes account-linked access records and may prevent restoring a purchase to that deleted FirstLane account. Your store retains its own transaction history.

7. Content, updates and availability

Downloaded material can be used offline, but a connection is needed for account actions, purchases, initial downloads, updates, progress sync and periodic access verification. Offline access is not a promise of indefinite use without reconnecting.

We may correct content and make changes for safety, quality, security or compatibility. We aim to preserve the essential value of purchased access. Where a material change or discontinuation affects that value, we provide appropriate notice and any remedy required by applicable law.

Practice content may contain errors or become outdated. Report a question through the app or Support. Technical problems or maintenance may temporarily interrupt service.

8. Acceptable use and ownership

We grant you a personal, limited, non-exclusive right to use FirstLane and legitimately unlocked content for your own study. FirstLane software, branding, original text and artwork belong to their respective rights holders. Government and third-party material retains its applicable rights and terms.

Do not bypass access controls, redistribute or sell paid material, scrape the service in bulk, interfere with infrastructure, attempt unauthorised account access, or use the service unlawfully. These restrictions do not override rights that the law expressly gives you.

9. Ending access and deleting an account

You can stop using FirstLane at any time and request account deletion on this website or in the app. Removing the app from a device is not the same as deleting your server account.

We may restrict access when reasonably necessary to address a serious breach, abuse, security risk or legal obligation. Where appropriate and lawful, we explain the reason and provide a route to resolve the issue. We do not turn a one-time purchase into a recurring subscription.

10. Responsibility and consumer rights

FirstLane is a study aid, and you remain responsible for safe driving and meeting official licensing requirements. We do not guarantee an exam result, uninterrupted availability, or compatibility with every device.

Nothing in these terms excludes a warranty, remedy or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including mandatory rights relating to digital content, consumer protection, privacy, fraud or personal injury. Any exclusion or limitation applies only to the extent permitted by applicable law.

Contact us about an issue so we can investigate and seek a reasonable resolution. These terms do not require you to waive access to courts, mandatory complaint routes, or any other non-waivable consumer rights.

11. Law and changes

Applicable law and mandatory consumer protections determine your rights. Nothing here prevents you from bringing a claim in a jurisdiction or forum to which you are legally entitled.

We may update these terms as FirstLane changes. Material changes will be communicated where required and will not retrospectively remove mandatory rights. The date above identifies this version.
